scripts.text:
[Morocc Soldier]
Hey, you! Stop there.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克士兵]
喂，你！站住。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Soldier]
This is a restricted area. You can't come any further!
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克士兵]
这里是禁区，不许再往前走了！

scripts.text:
[Morocc Soldier]
Hey, you! Stop there.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克士兵]
喂，你！站住。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Soldier]
This is a restricted area. You can't come any further!
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克士兵]
这里是禁区，不许再往前走了！

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
After that terrible incident wiped out the entire Morocc, Rune-Midgarts Kingdom has gathered us volunteers to help restorations.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
在那场可怕的灾难中，梦罗克全境被夷为平地。卢恩·米德加兹王国召集了我们这些志愿者，协助重建工作。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
As important as it seems, everyone's being careful but there are always some that really don't realize the situation, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
事情这么严重，大家都小心翼翼的，可总有人意识不到眼下的状况，你说是不是？

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
We're... We're flooded with work...
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
我们...我们忙得不可开交...

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
This work's like never-ending, no matter how hard we try!!!
People of Rune-Midgarts!! Please lend us a helping hand!!
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
这工作简直没完没了，无论怎么努力都干不完！！！
卢恩·米德加兹的人民啊！！请伸出援手吧！！

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
Haw.... Whew... Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
呼...呼...唉...

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
We're still unable to estimate the overall damage.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
目前我们还无法估算整体损失。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
Adventurers' Union and Prontera Kingdom are putting their efforts on restorations as well as restraints of the original cause of the disaster.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
冒险者公会和普隆德拉王国也在全力协助重建，同时设法遏制引发灾难的祸根。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
Unless we settle the original cause, the damage will even spread out of Morocc. The only thing left is to get worse.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
要是不解决祸根，灾害还会蔓延到梦罗克以外。情况只会更糟。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
As bad as it seems, we can't even ask for more support.
This sure must be the worst thing ever happened in Rune-Midgarts' history.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
情况看起来已经够糟了，但我们甚至无法请求更多的支援。
这恐怕是卢恩·米德加兹历史上最糟糕的事件了。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
I wish I knew how bad the damage is, but we can't even estimate it. It's like shovelling sand against the tide..
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
真想弄清楚损失有多大，可我们连估算都做不到。简直就像想靠铲沙挡住潮水...

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
The town's all shattered, but the real problem is the towners.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
城镇已经毁了，可更让人担心的是这里的居民。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
It's a real pity to see those victims of the destroyed town, but the witnesses of the disaster are so much shocked. They're simply not normal now.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
受灾的居民已经够可怜了，可亲眼见到灾难的人，受到的打击更大。他们现在的精神状态很不正常。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
People are scared to death, but those are fortunate at least.. cause.. many others got mentally ill and stuff..
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
有些人吓得魂飞魄散，可这还算幸运的...因为...还有不少人已经精神失常了...

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
Ugh.. It's kinda spooky, here.. Even this dry wind of the desert seems to have a dark nature.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
唉...这里有点阴森...连沙漠里干燥的风似乎都透着股邪气。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
Ooh!! Something... I can feel something! The dark and gloomy air flowing around this town is actually giving me a musical motiff!
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
噢！！有什么东西...我感觉到什么了！环绕这座城镇的阴暗气息，竟然给了我一段旋律的灵感！

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
Right, I think you should hear it! The title is.. 'The Rhapsody of Morocc Satan's Rebirth'!!
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
对，你一定得听听！曲名叫...《梦罗克撒旦重生狂想曲》！！

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
When finally wake up, it's just the same darkness
Failed to be reborn at the same place,
Gotta try harder and harder, never ever give up,
But even after hundreds and thousands of trying,
The great Satan of Morocc can't revive~
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
终于醒来，还是同样的黑暗
重生之地，复活又告失败，
再努力，再努力，绝不放弃，
哪怕尝试千次万次，
梦罗克的大撒旦仍无法复活~

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
My stupid button men are useless,
Against those adventurers,
This time I must revive,
Cracking the time and the space,
Will be saved for the last~~~
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
我那些蠢手下毫无用处，
根本敌不过那些冒险者，
这一次，我一定要复活，
撕裂时间与空间，
留作最后的手段~~~

scripts.text:
[Ringing Voice]
Be quiet! Can't you see what's going on?!
scripts.translation:
[回响的声音]
安静点！你没看见现在是什么状况吗？！

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
Heyyy, you're being too harsh, Se�orita. Your fist may be as fragile as you are, but it sure can hurt somebody.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
喂——小姐，你也太凶了。拳头跟你一样娇弱，可打起人来还真疼。

scripts.text:
[Ringing Voice]
Anyways, isn't that a crib? I think I heard something like that before..
scripts.translation:
[回响的声音]
话说回来，这不是抄来的吧？总觉得以前听过差不多的歌...

scripts.text:
[Morocc Volunteer]
No, No way!? It,, sure is not!
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克志愿者]
不，不可能！那...绝对不是！

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
The town's completely destroyed, but that giant triangular structure hasn't been harmed at all. Maybe it's protected by some kinda special power.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
城镇已经完全被摧毁了，但那个巨大的三角形建筑却毫发无损。也许它受到某种特殊力量的保护。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
You know...Those giant, triangular buildings at the NorthWest corner of Morocc known are known to us as Pyramids...
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
你知道吗...梦罗克西北角那些巨大的三角形建筑，我们称之为金字塔...

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Those things have been around here for thousands and thousands of years. No one knows when and why they were built, or who built them.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
这些建筑已经存在了成千上万年。谁也不知道它们是什么时候建的、为什么建，又是谁建的。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
All we know is that tons of monsters live inside those weird buildings. You might wanna stay away from those really dangerous places.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
我们只知道那些奇怪的建筑物里住着大量的魔物。你最好远离那些非常危险的地方。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Those monsters in the Pyramid would be very, very sensitive to sweet flash smell of people....
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
金字塔里的魔物，对人类鲜美的血肉气味可是非常、非常敏感...

scripts.text:
[Old Scholar]
I've devoted my life to researching the mysterious pyramids near Morocc. I haven't been able to concretely confirm anything yet, but...
scripts.translation:
[老学者]
我毕生致力于研究梦罗克附近神秘的金字塔。虽然我还无法确切证实任何结论，但是...

scripts.text:
[Old Scholar]
I'm sure that the largest pyramid contains the tomb of the ancient king, Osiris! I'm willing to stake my life on it!
scripts.translation:
[老学者]
我确信，最大的金字塔里一定有古代国王俄塞里斯的陵墓！我愿意为此赌上性命！

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
I remember I said the bandits of desert are the desert wolves.. Those bastards always roam around in a bunch and they would get so cruel and outrageous if one of them got attacked.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
我以前说过，沙漠狼就是沙漠里的强盗。那群混蛋总是成群结队地游荡，哪怕只攻击其中一只，它们都会变得凶残疯狂。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
They are so vicious, and I'm telling ya, I'm no kidding. You can only find some bones and rotten milk in the backpack after these wolves sweep through.
Those things are so mean and vicious..
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
它们凶得很，我可没开玩笑。狼群扫荡过后，背包里只剩些骨头和变质的牛奶。
这些家伙真是又坏又凶...

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
But the thing is that.. I even kinda feel those merciless cold-blooded monsters are nothing to be afraid of, compared to what has happened in Morocc. Morocc is already a hell.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
可是...跟梦罗克发生的事相比，连那些冷血无情的魔物，都好像没那么可怕了。
梦罗克已经成了地狱。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
I work in the trading business, so I always have to cross the hot, dry Morocc Desert on business.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
我是做生意的，以前为了跑商，总得穿过炎热干燥的梦罗克沙漠。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
But I can't do that anymore.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
但我不能再那样做了。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Now that I can't, I kind of miss the old days.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
如今去不了了，反倒有点怀念从前。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Like this one time, while I was in the middle of the desert, I got so thirsty that I caught a cactus.. but before I was able to cut it, it slapped me! Then it shot me in the arse with all these needles...
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
有一回，我走到沙漠中央，渴得不行，就抓了株仙人掌...可还没来得及切开，它竟然扇了我一巴掌！
接着，又朝我屁股射了一堆刺...

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Later, I learned that it wasn't a normal cactus I found, but the monster we call 'Muka.'
Now I come to think of it, it was fun as much as dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
后来才知道，那不是普通仙人掌，而是叫“摩卡”的魔物。
现在想想，危险归危险，也挺有意思的。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
The undisputed queen of jewels has to be the Diamond. After looking at it just once, no one can deny its beauty.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
要说宝石中的女王，那非钻石莫属。只要看上一眼，谁都得承认它的美。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Many factors determine its value, but the most important thing is its size.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
钻石的价值由很多因素决定，不过，最重要的还是大小。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
It should also be a perfect crystal, not cracked or chipped, if you want to sell the Diamond for a lot of zeny.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
想把钻石卖出很多 Zeny，它的晶体就必须完好，不能有裂纹或缺口。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
But look! The hardest stone in the world got broken in two!
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
但你看！世界上最坚硬的石头竟然断成了两半！

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
I know it's not the time to worry about some gemstones but.. this.. was my everything..
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
我知道现在不是担心宝石的时候，但是...这...是我的全部啊...

scripts.text:
[Drunken Young Man]
Wait a second..! Are you perhaps an adventurer? Welcome! How's your trip?
Heh heh~ Let me tell you a story. You know I just got out of that Tavern, there, huh?
scripts.translation:
[喝醉的年轻人]
等一下...！你是冒险者吧？欢迎欢迎！旅途怎么样？
嘿嘿~我给你讲个故事。看见那边的酒馆没？我刚从里面出来。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Young Man]
I heard the Satan Morocc has revived. It just got out of cracking the time and the space blar... hic~
scripts.translation:
[喝醉的年轻人]
听说魔王梦罗克复活了。它撕裂了时间和空间，就这么出来了，什么什么的...嗝~

scripts.text:
[Drunken Young Man]
Ah... I kinda wanna see that Satan with my own eyes, but! I really shouldn't. I shouldn't even dream of seeing that Satan in person.
scripts.translation:
[喝醉的年轻人]
啊...真想亲眼看看那个魔王，可是！我可不能去。
连当面见它的念头，都不该有。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Young Man]
But I think there'd be nothing to lose if you, a person of bravery, who came through the wile desert try to find it, don't you think? Teehee~ Don't forget to buy me a drink when you find it!
Hic!
scripts.translation:
[喝醉的年轻人]
不过，你这么勇敢，连荒芜的沙漠都穿过来了，去找找它也没什么损失吧？你说呢？嘿嘿~
找到它，别忘了请我喝一杯！
嗝！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Young Man]
Anyway, do you know where we are? I just had a little drink at a tavern, but all of a sudden, the whole town's disappeared when I got out.. or, some five hundred years have passed???!
scripts.translation:
[喝醉的年轻人]
话说，我们这是在哪儿？我不过在酒馆喝了一点，怎么一出来，整座城就没了...
难道已经过了五百年？？？！

scripts.text:
[Pale-looking Young Man]
... That day... I saw the bloody moon in the sky. It was too silent that it felt so spooky.
scripts.translation:
[脸色苍白的年轻人]
...那一天...我看见了天空中的血月。寂静得让人毛骨悚然。

scripts.text:
[Pale-looking Young Man]
Not even a whistle of dry wind, and the air so heavy and stuffy, I could hardly breathe.
scripts.translation:
[脸色苍白的年轻人]
连干燥的风声都没有，空气沉闷得让人几乎喘不过气。

scripts.text:
[Pale-looking Young Man]
But then, Bang! It was right that time that I saw the enormous amount of smoke rising up at the Castle of Morocc with an earsplitting sound.
scripts.translation:
[脸色苍白的年轻人]
然后，轰的一声！震耳欲聋！就在那时，我看见梦罗克城堡升起滚滚浓烟。

scripts.text:
[Pale-looking Young Man]
All happened so fast. The Oasis of the Castle was all dried up and the town was destroyed. And... and that voice... I heard a voice.
scripts.translation:
[脸色苍白的年轻人]
一切都太快了。城堡的绿洲干了，城镇也毁了。
还有...还有那个声音...我听见了一个声音。

scripts.text:
[Pale-looking Young Man]
Blood... Blood is what it takes to pay for the soul... and that dark sound of laughter...
Aah!!! It's... It's still ringing in my ears!!! Aahhhhh!!!!
scripts.translation:
[脸色苍白的年轻人]
血...灵魂的代价，必须用血来偿还...还有那阴森的笑声...
啊！！！它...它还在我耳边响！！！啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text: - It'd be better not to disturb him anymore -
scripts.translation: - 最好不要再去打扰他了 -

scripts.text:
[Little Girl]
-Crying-
scripts.translation:
[小女孩]
-哭泣-

scripts.text:
[Little Girl]
I'm so scared! Where's mom and dad...! hhooooo... Where's our house...
scripts.translation:
[小女孩]
我好害怕！爸爸妈妈在哪儿...！呜呜呜...我们的家呢...

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Please stop crying, Eliese... You could even faint if you cry all day long, you know...
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
别哭了，艾莉丝...哭一整天，会晕过去的...

scripts.text:
[Little Girl]
No! No... Mommy... Daddy....
scripts.translation:
[小女孩]
不要！不要...妈妈...爸爸...

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
............... Let's stop crying, Eliese...

[Little Girl]
Nooooooo... Mommy... Daddy....!!

[Little Boy]
Mom and Dad are now...
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
妈妈和爸爸现在...

scripts.text:
[Little Girl]
No...... noooooo...
scripts.translation:
[小女孩]
不要...不要啊...

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Right, you love ice-cream, don't you? I.. I can get you an ice-cream if you stop crying. Don't cry, Eliese, please.. Ok? Don't...
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
对了，你喜欢冰淇淋，是不是？只要你不哭，我...我就给你买一个。
艾莉丝，求求你，别哭了...好不好？别...

scripts.text:
[Syvia]
The fields of Rune-Midgarts are infested with wild and dangerous monsters..But, you've got to admit a bunch of them are soooo cute!
You know, like how Spore sticks out its tongue after you kill it..
scripts.translation:
[西薇娅]
卢恩·米德加兹的野外到处是危险的魔物...可你得承认，有些真的好——可爱！
比如魔菇，被打死以后还会吐舌头...

scripts.text:
[Syvia]
Or, how little Picky wears that tiny egg shell sometimes?..
scripts.translation:
[西薇娅]
还有小鸡，有时候会顶着一个小小的蛋壳，对吧？...

scripts.text:
[Syvia]
I can't believe what just has happened.. Our town used to be the one with those cute little monsters, not that kinda of vicious dreadful Evil sleeping in! Whew...
scripts.translation:
[西薇娅]
真不敢相信发生了这种事...我们的城镇以前只有那些可爱的小魔物，怎么会沉睡着那么凶残可怕的邪魔！唉...

scripts.text:
[Syvia]
I'm so scared... I just wanna ease my mind watching over those cute little Porings...
scripts.translation:
[西薇娅]
我好害怕...只想看看那些可爱的小波利，让自己安心一点...

scripts.text: What about Angeling?
scripts.translation: 天使波利呢？

scripts.text: How about Ghostring?
scripts.translation: 幽灵波利呢？

scripts.text: Quit Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Syvia]
Ooh! Angeling is just like Poring, except it has angel wings! Of course, I don't know if they can actually fly..
scripts.translation:
[西薇娅]
哦！天使波利跟波利差不多，只是多了一对天使翅膀！当然，我也不知道它们到底会不会飞...

scripts.text:
[Syvia]
Angelings are rarely seen, but can be found among large groups of Porings living in one of the fields south of Prontera.
Angeling is a high level monster with Holy property, so it's immune to most magic, aside from spells that have Neutral or Shadow attack properties.
scripts.translation:
[西薇娅]
天使波利很少见，不过，在普隆德拉南边的一片原野上，能在大群波利中找到它。
天使波利是圣属性的高等级魔物，能免疫大部分魔法，只有无属性或暗属性的法术例外。

scripts.text:
[Syvia]
Hehe~ Don't you think I know a lot about Porings? I love them soooo much
scripts.translation:
[西薇娅]
嘿嘿~我是不是很了解波利呀？我最——喜欢它们了！

scripts.text:
[Syvia]
Hehe... Poring... Hee......
scripts.translation:
[西薇娅]
嘿嘿...波利...嘻...

scripts.text:
[Syvia]
Ghostring is an evil ghost Poring. It's rarely seen, but can be found among mass groups of Porings living in one of the fields south of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[西薇娅]
幽灵波利是化为邪恶幽灵的波利。虽然很少见，但在普隆德拉南边的一片原野上，能在大群波利中找到它。

scripts.text:
[Syvia]
Ghostring is a high-leveled monster with the Ghost property, so it can withstand all physical attacks.
Damage can only be caused to Ghostring through magic spells or weapons with an a specific property.
scripts.translation:
[西薇娅]
幽灵波利是念属性的高等级魔物，能抵御所有物理攻击。
只有使用魔法或特定属性的武器，才能对它造成伤害。

scripts.text:
[Syvia]
Hehe~ Don't you think I know a lot about Porings? I love them soooo much~
scripts.translation:
[西薇娅]
嘿嘿~我是不是很了解波利呀？我最——喜欢它们了~

scripts.text:
[Syvia]
Hehe... Poring... Teehee......
scripts.translation:
[西薇娅]
嘿嘿...波利...嘻嘻...

scripts.text:
[Syvia]
Hehe... Poring... Teehee......
scripts.translation:
[西薇娅]
嘿嘿...波利...嘻嘻...

scripts.text:
[Akira]
Hey, you. Did you cross the desert?
scripts.translation:
[明]
嘿，你穿过沙漠吗？

scripts.text:
[Akira]
When you walk through the desert about one map North and 3 maps East, you'll find the entrance to Ant Hell.
scripts.translation:
[明]
从沙漠往北走一张地图，再往东走三张地图，就能找到蚂蚁地狱的入口。

scripts.text:
[Akira]
There are two different entrances to the Ant Hell. When you get inside, the 1st and the 2nd underground levels of winding looking caves are connected to each other.
scripts.translation:
[明]
蚂蚁地狱有两个入口，里面地下第一层和第二层的曲折洞穴互相连通。

scripts.text:
[Akira]
I'm really wondered how those entrances are after the horrible destruction, but I can't go out.. If you ever hear anything about it, please get me informed.
scripts.translation:
[明]
不知道那场可怕的灾难过后，入口变成什么样了。可我出不去...
要是你听到消息，请告诉我。

scripts.text: About 'Ant Hell'
scripts.translation: 关于“蚂蚁地狱”

scripts.text: About Ants
scripts.translation: 关于蚂蚁

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Akira]
That cave is sure a dangerous hell, sticky and all... There are 2 underground levels.
Just head East till you see the bridge which connects to the Payon Forest.
scripts.translation:
[明]
那个洞窟又黏又危险，简直是地狱...地下共有两层。
一直往东走，会看到一座通往斐扬树林的桥。

scripts.text:
[Akira]
In the map right before that bridge, head north to find the entrance to Ant Hell, though I'm not sure if it's still there.
scripts.translation:
[明]
在桥前面的那张地图往北走，就能找到蚂蚁地狱的入口，不过，我也不确定现在还在不在。

scripts.text:
[Akira]
Ant Hell is swarming with Ant monsters. You'll notice that they all classed with different names...
scripts.translation:
[明]
蚂蚁地狱里到处都是蚂蚁魔物。你会发现，它们分成好几种，各有各的名字...

scripts.text:
[Akira]
Andre is the weakest, Piere is comparatively average, and Deniro is the strongest Ant. Keep that in mind so you can fight the Ants suitable to your level.
scripts.translation:
[明]
白蚁最弱，工蚁实力居中，兵蚁最强。记住这一点，就能挑适合自己等级的蚂蚁来打。

scripts.text:
[Akira]
Andre is colored in Ivory, Yellowish Green is Piere, and the Red one is Deniro.
It's really easy to distinguish those from Bitata, the common ants because they look very different.
scripts.translation:
[明]
白蚁是象牙色，工蚁是黄绿色，兵蚁是红色。
它们和普通的黑蚁长得很不一样，很容易分辨。

scripts.text:
[Akira]
Oh, and those ants are greedy as Porings and will try to steal your items, so keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[明]
哦，那些蚂蚁也跟波利一样贪吃，会捡走你的物品，记得留意。

scripts.text:
[Akira]
If you ever, could cross the desert without any disturbances from the Satan...
scripts.translation:
[明]
要是你能避开魔王的干扰，穿过沙漠的话...

scripts.text:
[Akira]
There's also an old man called Guias, the spirit of the earth. He's pretty hard to deal with.
scripts.translation:
[明]
那里还有个叫基亚斯的大地之灵，是个难对付的老头。

scripts.text:
[Akira]
Sharp teeth and strong jaws of the ants would be something that you should be careful of, but the shovelling skills of that old grandpa is very strong that you should watch out.
scripts.translation:
[明]
蚂蚁的尖牙和强壮的下颚要小心，可那个老头的铲子功夫也厉害得很，一样得提防。

scripts.text:
[Akira]
...Well, what am I talking about? What is left to be afraid when the Satan of Morocc is revived? Huh..huhhuh...
scripts.translation:
[明]
...唉，我在说什么啊？魔王梦罗克都复活了，还有什么值得害怕的？呵...呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Slayer Kid]
Unbeatable in man-to-man fights, Assassins always overcome their enemies! Erm, always overcome their enemies without a trace.
scripts.translation:
[斩杀小子]
刺客单挑无人能敌，总能击败敌人！呃，而且不留痕迹。

scripts.text:
[Slayer Kid]
But what did they do when this destruction happened in Morocc!!!
scripts.translation:
[斩杀小子]
可梦罗克遭到毁灭的时候，他们又做了什么！！！

scripts.text: Where I can find the Assassin clan?
scripts.translation: 我在哪里可以找到刺客公会？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Slayer Kid]
I hear Assassins practice killing people, quietly and stealthfully..
scripts.translation:
[斩杀小子]
听说刺客练的，就是悄无声息、神不知鬼不觉地杀人...

scripts.text:
[Slayer Kid]
I left home three years ago, and have been searching for their secret base ever since...
Are they really that invisible?!
scripts.translation:
[斩杀小子]
三年前我离开家，就一直在找他们的秘密基地...
他们真有那么难找吗？！

scripts.text:
[Slayer Kid]
Well.. Maybe it'd too late now..
Now that the whole town's destroyed... I don't even care what happens next...
scripts.translation:
[斩杀小子]
嗯...也许现在太晚了...
整个城镇都被摧毁了...接下来发生什么，我都不在乎了...

scripts.text:
[Slayer Kid]
You know what...
It seemed to be impossible to find.
scripts.translation:
[斩杀小子]
你知道吗...好像根本找不到。

scripts.text:
[Slayer Kid]
Well, I hear that if you leave this town and go 2 maps east, and then 2 maps South, you should be able to find it..
scripts.translation:
[斩杀小子]
听说出城以后，往东走两张地图，再往南走两张，就能找到他们...

scripts.text:
[Slayer Kid]
The 'Mirage Tower,' the head building of Sograt Desert, is supposed to appear in this awesome sandstorm! But, I still haven't found it.
scripts.translation:
[斩杀小子]
据说苏克拉特沙漠的主要建筑“海市蜃楼塔”，会在那种惊人的沙暴里出现！可我还是没找到。

scripts.text:
[Slayer Kid]
If you find them, and the clan master thinks you're qualified, you can become an Assassin! Or, at least, I think..
scripts.translation:
[斩杀小子]
找到他们以后，只要公会首领觉得你够资格，就能成为刺客！至少...我想是这样。

scripts.text:
[Slayer Kid]
And I hear the coolest Assassin of them all is the Assassin Cross! But, that's even a bigger mystery~ You won't be able to see them unless you're a great thief!
scripts.translation:
[斩杀小子]
听说刺客里最酷的，就是十字刺客！不过，他们更神秘~
除非你是个了不起的盗贼，否则根本见不到他们！

scripts.text:
[Slayer Kid]
But then... What the hell were they doing when Morocc was destroyed?!!!
scripts.translation:
[斩杀小子]
可是...梦罗克被毁的时候，他们到底在干什么？！！！

scripts.text:
[Slayer Kid]
Assassin is one of the advanced jobs for Thief, and specializes in fighting with Neutral and Poison property attacks.
scripts.translation:
[斩杀小子]
刺客是盗贼的进阶职业之一，擅长使用无属性和毒属性攻击。

scripts.text:
[Slayer Kid]
They're also very sneaky! I hear that they're able to cloak so that no one can see them!
scripts.translation:
[斩杀小子]
他们还特别擅长潜行！听说能隐藏身形，让谁都看不见！

scripts.text:
[Slayer Kid]
But then... What the hell were they doing when Morocc was destroyed?!!!
scripts.translation:
[斩杀小子]
可是...梦罗克被毁的时候，他们到底在干什么？！！！

scripts.text:
[Dimitri]
The desert of Morocc has the highest average temperature in Midgard. You might as well think twice before you sit on the sand in the middle of the desert, cause your ass will be toasted.
scripts.translation:
[德米特里]
梦罗克沙漠的平均气温，是整个米德加尔特最高的。想在沙漠中央一屁股坐到沙子上，可得先想清楚，不然屁股都要烤焦了。

scripts.text: About the desert sands
scripts.translation: 沙漠里的沙子

scripts.text: About the remedy for Fatigue
scripts.translation: 怎么缓解疲劳

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Dimitri]
......What I mean is that...
It seems like it should be all burnt, but it's not!
scripts.translation:
[德米特里]
...我是说...按理屁股应该烤焦了，可其实不会！

scripts.text:
[Dimitri]
You can sit down and take a rest whenever you need to and your ass won't burn. I guess the Morocc sand doesn't conduct heat as much as it should.
scripts.translation:
[德米特里]
累了随时可以坐下休息，屁股也不会烫伤。看来梦罗克的沙子，并没有想象中那么容易导热。

scripts.text:
[Dimitri]
That's why everyone could recover the HP and SP in the middle of desert.
scripts.translation:
[德米特里]
所以，大家才能在沙漠中央恢复 HP 和 SP。

scripts.text:
[Dimitri]
Now I come to think of it, maybe the reason why Morocc has exceptionally high average temperature is because that Satan is sealed within.
scripts.translation:
[德米特里]
现在想想，梦罗克的平均气温异常高，或许就是因为那里封印着魔王。

scripts.text:
[Dimitri]
Recovery!
That's what the potions are for!
Red Potions have become steadily popular since they're so affordable, even though they only recover a little bit of HP.
scripts.translation:
[德米特里]
恢复体力！这就是药水的用处！
红色药水虽然只能恢复少量 HP，可价格便宜，所以一直很受欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Dimitri]
Try this bottle of ice-cold potion when you go into the Oasis around the Pyramid...
Yeah.. you want this bad.. but the situation's not good...
scripts.translation:
[德米特里]
去金字塔附近的绿洲时，喝一瓶冰镇药水试试...
是啊...你肯定很想喝，可眼下这状况...

scripts.text:
[Dimitri]
Sometimes 'Milk' comes out of 'PecoPeco's Egg.' Now..
I'm not sure how the cow's milk comes out of some bird's egg...
scripts.translation:
[德米特里]
“大嘴鸟的蛋”有时候会掉出“牛奶”。嗯...
我真不明白，牛奶怎么会从鸟蛋里掉出来...

scripts.text:
[Dimitri]
I may not be a man of science, but how is that even possible?.
I mean, did the Milk come prepackaged with the egg, or did it get in there somehow?..
Oh, whatever.. It's just not the time for this.
scripts.translation:
[德米特里]
我虽然不懂科学，但这怎么可能呢？
我是说，牛奶是预先包装在蛋里的，还是不知怎么混进去的？
算了...现在不是讨论这个的时候。

scripts.text:
[Armani]
Ooh, Woooowwww.
scripts.translation:
[阿玛尼]
噢，哇哦。

scripts.text:
[Armani]
I... I really saw it.... The Fly Lord gets shattered in pieces in a blink of an eye...
scripts.translation:
[阿玛尼]
我...我真的看见了...龙蝇眨眼之间就被打得粉碎...

scripts.text:
[Armani]
What is really going on? Would it be possible for us to survive??
scripts.translation:
[阿玛尼]
这到底是怎么回事？我们还能活下来吗？

scripts.text: The Fly Lord?!
scripts.translation: 龙蝇？！

scripts.text:
[Armani]
Yes, yes! I'm talking about the Dragon Fly, master of all flies!!
The Dragon Fly is a special one that stays in the North-east of the town.
scripts.translation:
[阿玛尼]
对，对！我说的就是龙蝇，所有苍蝇的老大！！
它可不是普通苍蝇，住在城镇东北边。

scripts.text:
[Armani]
It's so much stronger than the other flies.
scripts.translation:
[阿玛尼]
它比其他苍蝇强得多。

scripts.text:
[Armani]
And when you kill it, there's even a chance that you might earn a ^880000Clip^000000 item!
scripts.translation:
[阿玛尼]
打倒它，还有机会得到^880000夹子^000000呢！

scripts.text:
[Armani]
Anyways, don't you think the Satan Morocc is so cruel?
They may not be the same kind, but still isn't it cruel to take that monster's soul with a single blow?
scripts.translation:
[阿玛尼]
不过，魔王梦罗克也太残忍了吧？
就算不是同类，一击就夺走那个魔物的性命，也太狠了。

scripts.text:
[Armani]
What should we do when this dreadful evil has come to life again!
scripts.translation:
[阿玛尼]
这么可怕的邪魔又活过来了，我们该怎么办啊！

scripts.text:
[Phlanette]
Morocc is located in an extremely dry region, surrounded by desert.
No place in the world is as hot as Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[弗拉内特]
梦罗克位于极其干燥的地区，四周都是沙漠。
世界上没有比这里更热的地方了。

scripts.text:
[Phlanette]
I have a hunch that this hot and dry climate in Morocc is because of that Satan sealed deeper underground for so long.
scripts.translation:
[弗拉内特]
我总觉得，梦罗克这么炎热干燥，是因为魔王长期被封印在地下深处。

scripts.text: Tell me about the desert.
scripts.translation: 说说沙漠的事

scripts.text: Quit Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Phlanette]
Um.. I'll briefly tell ya about the desert if you want to know.
Due to low annual rainfall, low humidity and high evaporation rate, little vegetation can be found in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[弗拉内特]
嗯...你想了解的话，我就简单讲讲。
沙漠年降雨量少、湿度低，水分蒸发又快，所以很少有植物生长。

scripts.text:
[Phlanette]
Nonetheless, there are a few hardy plants that can survive and grow in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[弗拉内特]
尽管如此，还是有少数顽强的植物能在沙漠中生存和生长。

scripts.text:
[Phlanette]
Unfortunately some of those plants growing around Morocc have been mutated into monsters.
One of those is Muka, the mutated cactus..
scripts.translation:
[弗拉内特]
可惜，梦罗克附近的一些植物变异成了魔物。
比如摩卡，就是变异的仙人掌...

scripts.text:
[Phlanette]
However, now that the Satan has revived, no one's sure of what changes would be made in the life cycles of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[弗拉内特]
不过，魔王如今已经复活，梦罗克的生态会发生什么变化，谁也说不准。

scripts.text:
[Phlanette]
Here and there!
Sand everywhere...
Oh, I curse you, the desert of Morocc!!
Damn you!
scripts.translation:
[弗拉内特]
这里也是，那里也是！到处都是沙子...
梦罗克沙漠，我诅咒你！！可恶！

scripts.text:
[Phlanette]
But our of all this hatred, I didn't want it to be completely destroyed...
scripts.translation:
[弗拉内特]
可我再怎么讨厌这里，也没想过要让它彻底毁掉...

scripts.text:
[Phlanette]
How come it's never possible to know its value while it's still around?
scripts.translation:
[弗拉内特]
为什么总要等失去了，才懂得珍惜呢？

scripts.text:
[Hashisid]
...Assassins are trained
to approach their enemies stealthily,
 as well as
to shroud their intent.
For this purpose,
we never
look our targets in the eye.
scripts.translation:
[哈希西德]
...刺客受训，要懂得悄然接近敌人，也要隐藏自己的意图。
因此，我们从不直视目标的眼睛。

scripts.text: Notion of Assassin
scripts.translation: 刺客的理念

scripts.text: Quit Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Hashisid]
Well, then..
I'll tell you what it is!
Assassins ..
may be commonly known as
infiltrators and murderers
who kill without remorse.
scripts.translation:
[哈希西德]
好吧...我就说说吧！刺客在世人眼里，往往是潜入者，是杀人也不会内疚的杀手。

scripts.text:
[Hashisid]
In actuality,
the Assassin clan
is forbidden to harm innocent people,
or at least,
not without good reason
scripts.translation:
[哈希西德]
实际上，刺客公会禁止伤害无辜的人。至少，没有正当理由，绝不能伤害他们。

scripts.text:
[Hashisid]
Our true directive is to assassinate evil creatures,
and to use our stealth to gather intelligence
for the good of all Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[哈希西德]
我们真正的使命，是暗杀邪恶生物，利用潜行能力收集情报，为整个卢恩·米德加兹谋福祉。

scripts.text:
[Hashisid]
Once upon a time,
our ancestors would
smoke tobacco called 'Hashish'
before performing their duties.
However, we no longer do so,
since insect or animal monsters are
very sensitive to the smell.
scripts.translation:
[哈希西德]
很久以前，我们的祖先执行任务前，会吸一种叫“哈希什”的烟草。
不过，现在已经不这么做了，因为昆虫和动物类魔物对这种气味很敏感。

scripts.text:
[Hashisid]
We strictly prohibit
smoking or eating
anything that has
strong smell...
If you ever,
try eating those
smelly garlic bread with spices,
scripts.translation:
[哈希西德]
我们严禁吸烟，也禁止吃气味浓烈的食物...
要是你吃了加香料的蒜味面包，

scripts.text:
[Hashisid]
and try hiding against
those wild boars or wolves,
believe me,
you'll be ripped in pieces.
scripts.translation:
[哈希西德]
再想躲过野猪或狼的鼻子，相信我，你会被撕成碎片。

scripts.text:
[La Conte]
Once Thiefs are promoted
to Assassins, which is very professional
they will be able to vary their battle style.
their battle style.
There are 2 main battle styles available to Assassins.
They may either wield dual daggers,
or fight with a set of Katars!
scripts.translation:
[拉·孔特]
盗贼转职成专业的刺客后，就能采用不同的战斗方式。
主要有两种：双手各持一把短剑，或使用一对拳刃！

scripts.text: Specialty of Katar
scripts.translation: 拳刃的特点

scripts.text: Specialty of Dual Daggers
scripts.translation: 双短剑的特点

scripts.text: Quit Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[La Conte]
A set of Katars is
worn on both of the hands,
and allows Assassins
to quickly slash their enemies.
Anyone can buy a basic set of Katars
in Morocc somewhere.
Of course, only Assassins can use them.
scripts.translation:
[拉·孔特]
拳刃戴在双手上，让刺客能迅速斩击敌人。
梦罗克有地方出售基础拳刃，谁都能买，不过，只有刺客能使用。

scripts.text:
[La Conte]
The right Katar
usually does more damage,
while the left Katar
is used for the follow-through.
But since Katars are equipped on both hands,
you can't equip a shield or an extra weapon.
scripts.translation:
[拉·孔特]
右手拳刃通常负责主要伤害，左手拳刃则用来追击。
不过，两只手都戴着拳刃，就不能再装备盾牌或其他武器。

scripts.text:
[La Conte]
Compared to Dual Daggers,
Katars have faster attack speed.
Also, the ^663399Sonic Blow^000000 skill
can only be used with Katars.
scripts.translation:
[拉·孔特]
比起双短剑，拳刃的攻击速度更快。另外，^663399音速投掷^000000只能在使用拳刃时施展。

scripts.text:
[La Conte]
You can learn the Sonic Blow skill
at ^663399Level 4 Katar Mastery^000000.
If you're an Assassin,
it's a handy skill to know.
scripts.translation:
[拉·孔特]
将^663399拳刃修炼练到 4 级^000000，就能学习音速投掷。
对刺客来说，这是个很实用的技能。

scripts.text:
[La Conte]
Sonic Blow is the skill
that inflicts 8 continuous hits of
Neutral damage.
scripts.translation:
[拉·孔特]
音速投掷能连续攻击 8 次，造成无属性伤害。

scripts.text:
[La Conte]
Dual Daggers
enables you to equip
2 different kinds of Daggers
at the same time.
Of course,
there are other weapons you can equip
aside from daggers,
scripts.translation:
[拉·孔特]
双短剑的打法，可以同时装备两种不同的短剑。当然，除了短剑，也能装备其他武器，

scripts.text:
[La Conte]
but they'll probably
be lacking in attack speed.
So I suggest daggers.
Also, without a dagger
in your right hand,
 you won't be able to use
the ^663399Double Attack^000000 skill.
scripts.translation:
[拉·孔特]
不过，换成其他武器，攻击速度可能就慢了。所以，我推荐短剑。
而且，右手不拿短剑，就无法使用^663399二刀连击^000000。

scripts.text:
[La Conte]
So with Dual Daggers,
you would have a double attack
with the right hand dagger,
 and a single attack with your left hand weapon.
scripts.translation:
[拉·孔特]
这样，使用双短剑时，右手短剑能发动二刀连击，左手武器再补上一击。

scripts.text:
[La Conte]
So that's three strikes
in one blow!
You can't argue
against that kind of damage!
scripts.translation:
[拉·孔特]
也就是出手一次，攻击三下！这伤害可不容小看！

scripts.text:
[La Conte]
Hopefully
you will make good use of
the weapons at your disposal.
Remember
the importance of
strategy and
planning your attacks.
scripts.translation:
[拉·孔特]
希望你能善用手里的武器。别忘了讲究策略，事先规划好怎么进攻。
